review_method: Independent bounded source/native-evidence reviews with disjoint ownership, followed by primary integration and final existing-fixture checks.

findings.finding: Borrowed context pointers and destruction order require owned model contexts to outlive upload and die before geometry.
findings.resolution: Require a shared owner for every nonnull model context; declare owned geometries before models; keep physical states alive through final stream unregistration.
findings.validation: Source lifetime review and successful two-category diagnostic; no injected allocation-failure lifetime test.

findings.finding: The physical buffer helper can increment lock depth even on a failed COM Lock; early return skipped balancing.
findings.resolution: Snapshot depth and unlock an attempted failure only if depth advanced. Check remaining physical bytes before scene attachment or locking; do not rewind native cursors.
findings.validation: Installed probe capacity_guard=1 rejects before attachment/COM/queue mutation. COM failure branch source-reviewed only.

findings.finding: Printed tag/bounds presence was outside checked, and hierarchy bounds did not verify root bounds.
findings.resolution: Assert the installed four-tag order and compare the root BoundingBox directly with 24 file bytes at offset 73.
findings.validation: Both reader-only and full probe pass with all 1303 bytes consumed.

findings.finding: Pre-loop frequency checks could miss a wrong offset in the second coincident draw.
findings.resolution: Bind layout and indices per queued entry; query each stream buffer/offset/stride/frequency, index buffer and declaration identity inside each draw.
findings.validation: queued_bindings=2 at stream-1 offsets 0 and 144; draw and state restoration pass.

findings.finding: Clone copied words 104/108 correctly, but the diagnostic source supplied zero instead of the ordinary constructor defaults.
findings.resolution: Set source words 104/108 to FFFFFFFF using the native 00b18900 evidence; document that aggregate-zero clone state is not the ordinary constructor.
findings.validation: Saved native constructor evidence plus final build/probe; full ordinary object constructor remains separate.

sort_validation.primary_rerun: Native instance sort differential: cases=90 forced_heap=30 pointer_positions=5652 exact_permutation=1 finite_guard=1

limitations: Reviews are scoped to the reconstructed projections.
Native ABI, full command execution and gameplay are unverified.
Exceptional floating-point and failed COM Lock execution are not covered by the native sort corpus.
